prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-ready 2D game UI symbol contact sheet, fixed 3 columns by 2 rows
Primary request: Create exactly six distinct non-text symbolic seal glyphs for Nano Hunter's "Seal Resonance" HUD, arranged in a strict 3x2 contact sheet. Fixed order: top-left WIND = feather-like outward spiral; top-center THUNDER = branching angular shock pattern; top-right SWIFT STANCE = forward-thrusting open-form pattern; bottom-left WARD STANCE = concentric closed-form protective pattern; bottom-center PURSUIT PIERCING = strong horizontal penetration pattern; bottom-right SCATTER BREAK = outward-spreading radial burst pattern. These are abstract pictorial combat symbols, not language characters.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved 02 镇妖官印 art-direction anchor; Image 2 is the existing v5 Element frame material and line-language reference; Image 3 is the live 2048x1152 gameplay screenshot for actual HUD scale and dark-world contrast. Use them as references only; generate a new clean sheet.
Style/medium: one artist, one consistent line weight, polished hand-painted 2D game UI seals; Southern and Northern Dynasties eastern fantasy; royal demon-warden craft; Buddhist seal geometry; Shanhaijing restraint; Chinese ink and meticulous gongbi detail. Dark aged bronze structural strokes with restrained pale cyan/blue-violet/cinnabar energy accents. Each symbol must remain readable at 64px.
Composition/framing: exact 3 columns x 2 rows on a 3:2 landscape canvas; six equal square cells; exactly one centered symbol per cell; generous and equal internal padding; no grid lines, no cell frames, no shadow plates, no background tiles. Each symbol has equal visual weight and fits completely inside its own cell without touching or crossing cell boundaries.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background across the entire canvas, including gutters. Uniform edge-to-edge green only.
Constraints: exactly six symbols and no more; strict fixed positional order; every symbol must have a materially different silhouette and directional grammar, not merely a color swap. No letters, no words, no Chinese characters, no seal script, no pseudo-writing, no calligraphy, no numerals, no labels, no logos, no watermark. No people, faces, animals, masks, hands, weapons, or character silhouettes. No frames, rings used as cell borders, plaques, panels, shadows, glows spreading into adjacent cells, or decorative objects. Do not use #00ff00 anywhere in a symbol. Background must have no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, or lighting variation. Crisp edges, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no green spill.
Avoid: reordered cells, duplicate silhouettes, color-only variants, personified symbols, textual or rune-like marks, western heraldry, modern laboratory, biotechnology, sci-fi HUD, neon cyberpunk, overlapping cells, cropped symbols, extra ornaments.
boundary: Runtime technical candidate only. Human review must still approve visual identity, idle-to-active instrument continuity, pseudo-text absence, physical-size readability, provenance/license terms and Gate26H before final-art or release promotion.
